########## --help
$ update.py <ROOT> --help
exit 0
--- stdout
usage: update.py [-h] [--apply] [--check] [--budget] [--confirm-delete NAME] [--confirm-cleanup NAME] [root]

Bring a project's RiskRails files up to date with the installed plugin.

positional arguments:
  root

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --apply
  --check
  --budget              with --check: exit 1 when a root instruction file is
                        over its byte budget
  --confirm-delete NAME
                        a human confirms this run's gated rows (regenerate?,
                        delete?), and is recorded in the migration report;
                        only with --apply
  --confirm-cleanup NAME
                        a human confirms this run's [cleanup] deletions (run
                        logs and stale task files, git-ignored and not
                        recoverable through git); only with --apply.
                        --confirm-delete does not settle them
--- stderr
